title: Claims Desk Card — Deductibles, Caps, Included Claims and Condemnation on the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans
content:
Limits card for the claims desk, one row per tier of the Extended Equipment Warranty Plans. Every figure is the tier's own; a plan's limits are those of the tier it was written at.

| Tier | Deductible per approved claim | Ceiling on one approved claim | Ceiling over one term | Approved claims included per term | Surcharge per approved claim beyond the included claims | Replacement allowance where a unit is condemned | Condemnation threshold (share of replacement cost) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Warranty Registration | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 | 0 USD | 0 USD | 0 percent |
| Parts Protection Plan | 150 USD | 2500 USD | 6000 USD | 2 | 350 USD | 0 USD | 0 percent |
| Parts & Labor Protection Plan | 125 USD | 6000 USD | 15000 USD | 3 | 300 USD | 0 USD | 0 percent |
| Compressor Coverage Plan | 250 USD | 12000 USD | 30000 USD | 4 | 275 USD | 3500 USD | 65 percent |
| Major Component Protection Plan | 200 USD | 20000 USD | 55000 USD | 6 | 250 USD | 8000 USD | 60 percent |
| Total Equipment Protection Plan | 0 USD | 45000 USD | 120000 USD | 12 | 0 USD | 22000 USD | 55 percent |

## What each column is

- **Deductible per approved claim** — the amount billed to the owner on each approved claim.
- **Ceiling on one approved claim** — the most one approved claim pays.
- **Ceiling over one term** — the most the plan pays over one cover term.
- **Approved claims included per term** — the number of approved claims in a term before the per-claim surcharge applies.
- **Surcharge per approved claim beyond the included claims** — the surcharge carried by each approved claim past that number.
- **Replacement allowance where a unit is condemned** — the allowance toward a new unit where a covered unit is condemned.
- **Condemnation threshold** — the share of the unit's replacement cost a covered repair must reach for the unit to be condemned.

## Card readings on hypothetical figures

- **Included claims.** On the Parts & Labor Protection Plan, 3 approved claims are included per term; a fourth approved claim in the same term is a claim beyond the included claims and carries the 300 USD surcharge, and the third does not.
- **Zero rows.** The Manufacturer Warranty Registration shows 0 USD in every money column and 0 included claims; the Total Equipment Protection Plan shows a 0 USD deductible and a 0 USD surcharge while its ceilings are 45000 USD per claim and 120000 USD per term.
- **Condemnation figures.** A replacement allowance is shown only on the three tiers with a condemnation threshold: 3500 USD at 65 percent (Compressor Coverage Plan), 8000 USD at 60 percent (Major Component Protection Plan) and 22000 USD at 55 percent (Total Equipment Protection Plan); the three lower tiers show 0 USD and 0 percent.
- **Two ceilings side by side.** On the Compressor Coverage Plan one approved claim never pays more than 12000 USD, and the plan never pays more than 30000 USD across the term.
